notes.text: The page starts with the displayed sequence (1) and a germ of a lifting (2) from an open subgroup Gamma-prime. It then chooses, under the circled III, a universal cover and writes the fundamental group as its automorphism group. The page proceeds to an extension (3), sets with an action of the extension group (4), actions on I and J through cal G-prime, and the displayed applications (5). The extension group’s letter remains marked E/Sigma. This is an account of the source, not a proof of its assertions.

The two oblique reminders ask about the relation with “variations des corps de base” and the relation between points over barred Q and “scindages partiels de l’extension (3)”. Neither note states or proves that correspondence. The cancelled word “posons” and the cancelled duplicate “(3)” are retained.

The final map strokes and the last link of extension (3) are headless in the manuscript. They are retained as bars even though the accompanying words call the final expressions applications. No mathematical regularization was used to add arrowheads. After the independent reading, the main reader supplied a shared notation decision: use fraktur X for the recurring looped form, and retain the extension glyph as unsure between calligraphic E and Sigma. These decisions are reflected consistently in the candidate.
The sheet carries a top-right pencil 5 and a bottom-left pencil 9. No date is written on this page. Their distinct positions are preserved; the numbering hand has not been independently identified.

raw_difference_disposition: All 38 packet difference entries were inspected against both full-resolution halves. Material differences are covered individually or within one mathematical expression by the changes rows, including readings retained from C. Pure macro syntax, braces around math alphabets, display wrappers, line wrapping, and H’s editorial page/synopsis or marginal-location prose were excluded. The separate Gamma-prime-subset-Gamma parenthetical supplied by H was assessed as non-source duplication, not ignored as markup. The full page and each half were viewed once; seven unique tight crops were created from the original, each only once. No web, OCR, recognition software or TeX compilation was used. The main reader subsequently supplied common notation decisions for X, the provisional E/Sigma glyph, and Q rendering; these were applied without reading any other page.
main_adjudication: All 21 reported loci checked on the supplied image and 13 saved crops; the six additional main-reader crops cover loci not included in reader crops. Candidate retained, including explicit E/Sigma uncertainty. Fraktur encoding is a glyph representation decision and is not counted as a change to the mathematics.
